mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members (phone, openid, nickname, avatar, growth_points, points, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{phone}, NULL, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE nickname = VALUES(nickname), avatar = VALUES(avatar), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT id, phone, openid, nickname, avatar, growth_points, points, created_at, updated_at FROM members WHERE phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, phone, openid, nickname, avatar, growth_points, points, created_at, updated_at FROM members WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
